citations.quote: The bond floor or the investment value is the value of the convertible if it were to be stripped of the possibility to convert into the underlying shares.
Convertible securities are hybrid issues that have fixed-income and equity characteristics.
Convertible bonds are issued in either domestic, foreign, or Eurobond form.
For example, options can be combined with bonds to form either callable bonds or convertible bonds.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: A convertible bond is a corporate-debt instrument whose holder owns an embedded right to surrender the bond for a fixed number of issuer shares; until conversion or maturity it pays coupons like an ordinary corporate bond, with conversion price K_c = F / q derived from face F and conversion ratio q, and call/put provisions modifying the bond-plus-call decomposition.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Convertible Bond Anatomy and Cashflows
